summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0). core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights, not in sub-tasks but also called validateApp) pass owner matching package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in-repo and is inlined at build, so one atomic PR was needed (separate PRs would break startup); owner values hard-coded, not read from package.json. CI and CD green.
